quote: Why do you chase shadows in the dark? When the light was always inside you. We spend years building walls to feel safe. Only to find ourselves completely trapped inside them. Every heavy secret makes the cage grow smaller. Until your own breathing feels like a stranger. Drop the heavy stones you carry around today. And let your tired spirit finally learn to rest.
